mutants.note: Checked by brute force over every YYYY-MM-DD (MM,DD 00-99, five years incl. leap and century years) that Date.parse accepts (1,860 dates): Date.parse already rejects month 00/13+ and day 00/32+, and any rollover of day 29-31 lands on day 1-3 of the next month, so month and day always differ together and || equals && on every reachable input.

mutants.note: Only the seconds clause flips. Date.parse returns NaN for every seconds value 61-99 (checked 00-99), and 60 is now handled before Date.parse as a leap second, so +s > 60 is never reached with a value above 60; the clause is a belt-and-braces guard.

real_defects.issue: Line numbers in a cleartext-signed file counted from the start of the signed payload, not the file: every field and every 'Line N is not a field' finding pointed 3+ lines too high (BEGIN line, Hash header, blank line, plus anything before BEGIN). unwrapSignature now returns lineOffset and parseSecurityTxt adds it.

parseExpires rejected an RFC 3339 leap second (Expires: 2027-06-30T23:59:60Z) as 'not a valid timestamp', a danger, because Date.parse returns NaN for second 60 even though the code meant to allow it (+s > 60). Now parsed as :59 plus one second.

Content-Type 'text/plain; charset="utf-8"' (a quoted parameter, legal under RFC 2045) got the 'served without charset=utf-8' notice, and 'charset=utf-8x' passed. The check now parses the parameter, quoted or not, and requires it to end there.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
